_meta.description: REAL, provider-published non-hospital CASH prices for NH, captured from official provider price pages during a 2026-08-16 research sweep. These are ingested as NON-PUBLIC candidate_review rows (publication_status != 'publishable') so nothing reaches consumers automatically — promotion to public requires human review, exactly like hospital mapping approvals. Prices are transcribed verbatim from the cited source; none is inferred or estimated. Missing prices stay 'price not available' (never $0).
_meta.policy: Candidate discovery is separate from approved public mappings. Mapping a provider's published line item to a canonical Carevero procedure is a human-review step; the canonical_slug here is a PROPOSED exact-name match, not an approved public mapping.

_dtc_reference.description: VERIFIED national direct-to-consumer (DTC) self-pay lab prices, organization/product-level (NOT location-specific). This is REFERENCE data only — the ingest does not read this key, so these never become per-location publishable prices. Publishing DTC labs to consumers requires a dedicated org-level DTC price surface (see docs/NH_LAB_PRICE_ARCHITECTURE.md); until then Quest candidates stay candidate_review and LabCorp is not ingested. Do NOT expand these into 14 per-location prices.

organizations.source_format: questhealth.com consumer product pages (national direct-to-consumer; JS-rendered, each read in-browser 2026-08-17). Per-product source URL is on each item.
organizations.price_scope: NATIONAL direct-to-consumer online-purchase price (questhealth.com), NOT location-specific and NOT ordinary walk-in cash billing. The test is PURCHASED through the DTC product, then collected at any of 2000+ Quest locations — so a single national price is an ORGANIZATION/PRODUCT-level price, NOT 14 NH-location-specific prices. Every product carries a flat, REQUIRED $6.00 physician service fee (an independent provider order); cash_price here is the TOTAL a consumer pays (test + required fee), with the component breakdown preserved. No CPT/test code is published. Staged org-wide as NON-PUBLIC candidates only; promotion will NOT publish lab candidates (no imaging modality gate) and requires per-location service evidence + a DTC-vs-walk-in comparability decision.
